caption: The drawing depicts a single metallic object centered on a plain, light beige background. The object resembles a decorative clamp or vise. Its main feature is a sculpted bird, possibly a songbird, rendered in shades of gold and brown, with defined wings and tail feathers extending backward. Atop the bird’s back is a green, rounded knob. The base of the bird connects vertically to a rectangular, ornate frame with engraved details and a screw mechanism. At the bottom of the screw extends a small, round handle with a quatrefoil (four-lobed) shape. The entire object is illustrated with detailed texture and subtle shading, emphasizing the metallic sheen and carved patterns. The composition is simple, with the subject placed in the center and ample blank space surrounding it. The artist's name is inscribed in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Hummingbird Holder
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
